create_afmoe_config: create an AfmoeConfig instance with default model parameters for the AFMoE architecture
configure_afmoe_layers: configure AfmoeConfig with custom layer types alternating sliding and full attention patterns
set_afmoe_moe_parameters: set AfmoeConfig with custom MoE parameters including num_experts, num_experts_per_tok, and num_shared_experts
initialize_afmoe_model: initialize an AfmoeModel using an AfmoeConfig instance for model construction
inspect_afmoe_config_attributes: inspect AfmoeConfig attributes such as hidden_size, vocab_size, and rope_parameters for model inspection
